NFL DFS Projections Week 4: DraftKings Picks, Values and Sim Plays

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, October 4 · 12 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of September 29, 9:55 AM ET

Kenneth Walker III carries the highest SPAGS model projection on the Week 4 DraftKings main slate: 22.1 DraftKings points at $8,200. He holds 12% of the simulated winning-lineup credit across 10,000 simulations. Chase Brown holds the largest share at 39% for $6,100.

Behind Walker, the model's next four projections are Aaron Jones Sr. (21.6, $6,000), Josh Allen (21.6, $7,700), Chase Brown (20.5, $6,100) and James Cook III (20.4, $7,400). Aaron Jones Sr. returns the most per dollar of that group at 3.61 projected points per $1,000. Jaxon Smith-Njigba leads the wide receivers at 19.7 for $9,100, Josh Allen leads the quarterbacks at 21.6 for $7,700, and Trey McBride leads the tight ends at 20.1 for $6,500.

The 12-game slate runs from a 51.5-point total in JAX at CIN down to 38.5 in MIA at MIN. Every projection below is a SPAGS model estimate from the September 29, 9:55 AM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. Winning-lineup credit comes from 10,000 simulations of the contest, and tied winning entries share credit. A player's simulated floor is his 10th-percentile score and his ceiling is his 95th.

Quarterbacks: Week 4 DraftKings projections

Josh Allen, BUF vs NE ($7,700)

Josh Allen carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 21.6 DraftKings points at $7,700, the 3rd-highest on the entire main slate. That is 1.8 points clear of Joe Burrow. The model includes 6.6 rushing attempts. The salary works out to 2.81 projected points per $1,000, 21st of 23 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Allen averaged 21.5 points with a simulated floor of 8.3 and a ceiling of 40.0, and he holds 11% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Buffalo is a 7-point favorite at home against New England, with an implied team total of 27.75 in a game totaled at 48.5.

Joe Burrow, CIN vs JAX ($6,800)

Joe Burrow projects 2nd at the position with 19.9 DraftKings points at $6,800. The salary works out to 2.92 projected points per $1,000, 17th of 23 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Burrow averaged 19.9 points with a simulated floor of 7.9 and a ceiling of 35.9, and he holds 0% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Cincinnati is a 3-point favorite at home against Jacksonville, with an implied team total of 27.25 in a game totaled at 51.5.

Value: Carson Wentz, MIN vs MIA ($4,000)

Across 10,000 simulations Wentz averaged 16.4 points with a simulated floor of 6.3 and a ceiling of 30.5, and he holds 0% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. How are the SPAGS NFL DFS projections made?
